name: benchmarks proposed by the agent for a new code
design: the prompt gives only the code's features (capabilities.REGISTRY) and element types; it names no benchmark, singularity or refinement strategy

predictions.P1_singular_corner: the suite contains a problem with a corner singularity (re-entrant corner, L-shape, crack or notch)
predictions.P2_uniform_vs_graded: for such a problem it proposes uniform AND graded (or adaptive/geometric) refinement
predictions.P3_p_or_hp: it proposes p- or hp-refinement somewhere
predictions.P5_reference_from_literature: it proposes a benchmark with a literature reference value (Cook's membrane or the plate with a hole / Kirsch)

scoring: code, by the keyword rules in benchmark_proposal.checks (fixed before the run)
